per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must respond to user actions within approximately 5 seconds to maintain user satisfaction and prevent disruptions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict actions such as opening disputes or making account adjustments to authorized personnel only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must ensure that reps can only view cases and cardholder information that they are authorized to access, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide a single-page workflow for reps to perform essential tasks without excessive clicking, enhancing usability and efficiency.
The system must maintain high availability during business hours, with limited maintenance windows scheduled during early morning hours.
The system must integrate with existing authoritative data sources, such as the transaction store, member information store, and billing/posting system, to ensure data consistency and accuracy.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle a peak load of approximately 350 concurrent users without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must log every user action, including opening cases, editing notes, sending letters, and requesting adjustments, to ensure auditability and compliance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must ensure that data is sourced from authoritative systems to maintain data integrity and prevent errors.
